[[File:Kousaku Anakubo.jpg|thumb|x250px|right|Anakubo in 2017[https://archive.is/r6TST Anakubo in 2017.]]] '''Kosaku Anakubo''' (穴久保幸作 ''Anakubo Kosaku''), born April 18th, 1957, is the creator of the manga series [[Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] and its sequels: [[Pokémon Ruby-Sapphire]], {{OBP|Pocket Monsters DP|Kosaku Anakubo}}, {{OBP|Pocket Monsters HGSS|Kosaku Anakubo}}, {{OBP|Pocket Monsters BW|Kosaku Anakubo}}, and {{OBP|Pocket Monsters XY|Kosaku Anakubo}}. He is also an artist for the Duel Masters Trading Card Game for the card Mauchu,{{fact}} One Extreme,{{fact}} and he is the author of Ore we Otoko da! Kunio-kun,{{fact}} an action and comedy manga that won the Shogakukan Manga Award for children in 1995.{{fact}} Kosaku Anakubo has two pet cats, Chinmi and Aiya.{{fact}} There are many references to his cats' names in early chapters of the Pokémon Pocket Monsters manga.{{fact}} ==Pokémon Pocket Monsters== Anakubo's most famous work is the Pokémon gag manga, [[Pokémon Pocket Monsters]]. It was one of the first ever [[Pokémon manga]] and remains one of the longest running Pokémon manga to date. It was serialized in [[CoroCoro]] from when it was first created. The manga is about the adventures of a young boy named {{OBP|Red|Pocket Monsters}} and {{TP|Red|his rude Clefairy|Clefairy}}. After fourteen volumes, the original series ended, but the adventures of the main characters continued in [[Pokémon Ruby-Sapphire]] (which takes place in [[Hoenn]]), [[Pocket Monsters DP (Kosaku Anakubo)|Pocket Monsters DP]] (which takes place in [[Sinnoh]]), [[Pocket Monsters HGSS (Kosaku Anakubo)|Pocket Monsters HGSS]] (in which the main characters return to Johto), [[Pocket Monsters BW (Kosaku Anakubo)|Pocket Monsters BW]] (which takes place in [[Unova]]), [[Pocket Monsters XY (Kosaku Anakubo)|Pocket Monsters XY]] (which takes place in [[Kalos]]), [[Pocket Monsters Sun Moon (Kosaku Anakubo)|Pocket Monsters Sun Moon]] (which takes place in [[Alola]]), and [[Pocket Monsters Aniki (Kosaku Anakubo)|Pocket Monsters Aniki]] (which takes place in [[Galar]]). ===Controversy=== Though ''Pocket Monsters'' was a success, it was briefly taken off the shelves due to nudity in the [[PM002|second chapter]] of [[Pokémon Pocket Monsters volume 1|volume one]].{{fact}} There was also some nudity in [[Pokémon Pocket Monsters volume 2|volume two]]. ==Artwork== This is a collection of official Pokémon artwork drawn by Anakubo. ===Animation=== This is a collection of art for animation that Anakubo has contributed to.
